context-lost.description: The system fails to maintain context in follow-up queries, leading to repeated or irrelevant results.

duplicate-events.description: The system shows duplicate events, indicating a failure in deduplication.

incorrect-event-details.description: The system provides incorrect details about events, such as wrong names or times.

missing-events.description: The system fails to find events that are known to exist, possibly due to incorrect filtering or database issues.

no-events-found/no-events-in-bergamo.description: No events found in Bergamo or nearby, possibly due to limited coverage or a narrow search radius.

no-events-found/no-events-in-torino.description: No events found in Torino, possibly due to limited coverage or a narrow search radius.

no-events-found/no-events-near-me.description: No events found near the user's location, possibly due to a narrow search radius or limited coverage.

no-events-found/no-events-specific-date.description: No events found for a specific date or week, possibly due to limited coverage or a narrow search window.

no-events-found/no-events-specific-genre.description: No events found for a specific genre, possibly due to limited coverage or a narrow search window.

successful-event-query.description: The system successfully finds and presents relevant events based on the user's query.
